steps.eval: import('/layout.js').then(({Layout}) => { const timed = (name, f) => function (...a) { const t = performance.now(); try { return f.apply(this, a); } finally { performance.measure(name, {start: t}); } }; const {save, changed} = Layout.prototype; Layout.prototype.changed = timed('changed', changed); Layout.prototype.save = function (map) { for (const [n, l] of this.live) if (l.pane?.save && !l.pane.save.timed) l.pane.save = Object.assign(timed(`save ${n.pane}`, l.pane.save), {timed: true}); return timed('save', save).call(this, map); }; })

steps.note: window.__saves = Object.entries(Object.groupBy(performance.getEntriesByType('measure').filter((m) => /^(save|changed)/.test(m.name)), (m) => m.name)).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ×${v.length} max ${Math.max(...v.map((m) => m.duration)).toFixed(1)} ms`).join(', ')
